title: Job 26
paragraphs: ¹ Then Job answered and said, ² How you have helped the powerless! What strength you have given to the feeble arm! ³ What counsel you have offered to one without wisdom! What sound insight you have so abundantly declared! ⁴ To whom have you been speaking these words? And whose breath came out of your mouth?

⁶ The dead tremble beneath the waters, and so do those who dwell there. ⁷ He spreads out the northern skies over empty space; he hangs the earth over nothing. ⁸ He wraps up the waters in his clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their weight. ⁹ He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his clouds over it. ¹⁰ He marks out the horizon on the face of the waters as the boundary between light and darkness.

¹¹ The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke. ¹² By his power he stilled the sea; by his wisdom he struck down Rahab. ¹³ By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent. ¹⁴ And these are only the outer fringes of his work — how faint a whisper we hear of him! Who can understand the thunder of his full power?
